claims.text: If abx chosen for ABRS: amoxicillin ± clavulanate first-line, 5-7 days for most adults
claims.quote: If a decision is made to treat ABRS with an antibiotic agent, the clinician should prescribe amoxicillin with or without clavulanate as first-line therapy for 5-7 days for most adults.
claims.locator: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update (AAO-HNSF, 2025), key action statements as reproduced by Guideline Central

claims.quote: Children should be treated for 10 to 14 days.
